title: How to Never Find a Playboy in Islamabad. Tip #1
body: Check the rotation before you check the feelings. If every date is SIP Cafe, or the same table at Street 1, you're one of several. If he calls everyone "yaar" so nothing ever needs a label, that's on purpose. If his close friends list has forty girls he "doesn't really talk to anymore," that's the group. Ask about his last situationship and count how fast it becomes "it wasn't that deep." If three different friend groups in F-7 have the exact same story about him, and none of them have ever compared notes, you already have your answer.
caption:
Tip #1: the Monal rotation always gives it away.
